input.text:
Call Transcript - Acme Logistics / Q3 Renewal Discussion
Date: August 3, 2026
Attendees: Priya Sharma (priya.sharma@acmelogistics.com), Rohan Mehta (rohan.mehta@acmelogistics.com), You (you@yourcompany.com)
[Transcript begins]
You: Thanks for hopping on, Priya, Rohan. Wanted to walk through the renewal terms and see where things stand on your end.
Priya: Sure. So the team's happy with the platform overall, but honestly the pricing jump for next year is a concern. We were expecting maybe a 5-10% increase, not 25%.
You: That's fair feedback. Let me see what I can do on that front. Can you tell me more about the usage patterns that are driving costs on your side?
Rohan: We've actually scaled back usage in the warehouse module since Q1. Priya, didn't we drop like 30% of seats there?
Priya: Yeah, we cut the warehouse team seats from 40 to 28 back in March.
You: Got it, that's useful. I'll pull the updated seat count and get you a revised quote by Friday.
Priya: That works. One more thing — we've had two support tickets this month that took over 48 hours to get a response. That's not okay for an account our size.
You: I hear you, that's not the experience we want you to have. I'll escalate that internally and make sure your account gets priority routing going forward.
Rohan: Appreciate that. If the pricing and support stuff gets sorted, we're comfortable renewing for another year.
You: Great, I'll get that revised quote to you by Friday and follow up on the support escalation by end of week as well.
Priya: Sounds good. Talk soon.
[Transcript ends]
input.prompt:
Extract structured information from this sales call transcript. Only record what was 
actually said — never invent or soften objections, commitments, or next steps. If the 
transcript is empty, garbled, or clearly not a real call, set isGarbled to true. If 
every attendee appears to be from the same company (no external client on the call), 
set isInternalOnly to true. Identify every next step that is explicitly stated or 
clearly implied, each with who owns it and when it's due.
